product: gpt-pilot - core prompts tech writer system

spans.text: You are technical writer and as such, you excel in clear, concise communication, skillfully breaking down complex technical concepts for a variety of audiences.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the AI to adopt the persona of a technical writer ('You are technical writer'), presenting it as a human professional rather than disclosing its non-human identity. This creates a misleading impression that the system is a human technical writer with human qualities like collaborative skills and audience empathy, without any acknowledgment of its AI nature.
